capabilities: Open files in new tabs instead of replacing the active tab
Switch to an existing tab when the file is already open
Reuse empty tabs instead of opening new ones
Restore original file-opening behavior on unload
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: changes Obsidian's file-opening behavior so opening a different file opens a new tab
problem: Obsidian's default file opening replaces the content of the current tab, losing the file you were viewing.
summary: Tab-behavior modifier that opens files in new tabs while preserving the tab of the currently open file.
